decisions.reason: The 65 mm bushing-space and wider locking-thread changes do not alter the candidate's current bushing location, attachment, clearance, or piston-rod-path rules.
The locking-thread and bushing-space changes leave the independently stated keyway omission unchanged.
The changed locking-interface dimensions do not modify the established raw material, premachining purpose, welding sequence, or post-weld internal machining requirement.
Changing locking-thread width and bushing-space length does not affect the assembly-aligned drawing-numbering rule.
The geometric changes do not change the specified S355 JRG2 and CuSn12 material selections.
The revised locking-interface geometry does not alter the requirement to comply with the usual ČSN/EN drawing standards.
The dimensional design changes do not alter the client-supplied drawing setup reference.
The geometry changes do not modify the required IPT or STEP delivery formats.

Although the source supplies revised design dimensions that drawings must represent, those dimensions are already owned by the source Requirement and do not change any existing candidate attribute or scope at this time.
